## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 1 passages

- **ep**: Julie K. Brown's Miami Herald investigation, published in November 2018, located and interviewed victims, reconstructed the non-prosecution agreement, and made the case unignorable. It is the single most consequential act of journalism in this record. The federal case that followed in 2019 is directly downstream of it — which means the mechanism that finally moved was a newspaper series, not any institution with jurisdiction.
